content.value_statement: Roadmap work can diverge from ClickUp when updates happen in separate places. This skill defines mappings, setup steps, and sync workflows for a consistent process.
actual_capabilities: Maps local epics and milestones to ClickUp tasks and subtasks.
Explains status mappings between a local roadmap and ClickUp.
Documents configuration fields for workspace, space, folders, and sync links.
Lists setup, push, pull, sync, status, link, and unlink commands.
Explains a documented MCP registration command and OAuth authentication step.
Describes conflict rules for status, points, and titles.
limitations: It does not execute synchronization or authenticate on the user behalf.
It requires a configured ClickUp account and the ClickUp MCP service.
It does not define how local roadmap files are created or parsed.
Its conflict rules may not fit every team workflow.

use_cases.title: Set up a team roadmap connection
use_cases.description: Configure workspace, space, and Epic folder details before linking a shared roadmap.

use_cases.title: Prepare a safe sync routine
use_cases.description: Pull remote changes, review status, and use dry runs before pushing roadmap updates.

use_cases.title: Resolve mapped item conflicts
use_cases.description: Apply the documented rules when ClickUp and local roadmap values differ.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the mapping
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how local epics, milestones, and statuses map to ClickUp items.

prompt_templates.title: Plan the setup
prompt_templates.prompt: List the information I need before configuring this ClickUp roadmap integration.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a sync checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a checklist for pulling changes, reviewing a dry run, and pushing roadmap updates to ClickUp.

prompt_templates.title: Handle a conflict
prompt_templates.prompt: My local title differs from ClickUp, and the task status also differs. Explain which values win and why.

output_examples.input: How should planned and done roadmap items map to ClickUp?
output: Milestones map to subtasks under an Epic.

output_examples.input: What should I do before pushing roadmap changes?
output: Use a dry run to preview the update.
Check sync status before the push.

best_practices: Review and approve the MCP registration command before running it.
Pull ClickUp changes before pushing local updates.
Use a dry run and check status before a full synchronization.
anti_patterns: Do not push changes before checking for remote updates.
Do not authenticate an MCP connection in an unintended ClickUp account.
Do not assume the documented conflict rules fit every project without review.

faq.question: What does this skill connect?
faq.answer: It documents synchronization between local roadmaps and ClickUp through the ClickUp MCP.

faq.question: What maps to a ClickUp Epic?
faq.answer: A local Epic maps to a ClickUp task with the Epic type.

faq.question: What maps to a ClickUp subtask?
faq.answer: A local milestone maps to a subtask under an Epic.

faq.question: Does the skill authenticate automatically?
faq.answer: No. The documented process requires the user to authenticate through OAuth.

faq.question: Which value wins when statuses conflict?
faq.answer: The documented rule gives the current ClickUp status priority.

faq.question: Should I push before pulling?
faq.answer: No. Pull remote changes first, then review a dry run before pushing.
